children: HC Wainwright & Co. reiterated their Buy rating on Cardiol Therapeutics's stock with a price target of $9.00.
The price target implies an upside of 237.1% from the Sep 22 close of $2.67.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Cardiol Therapeutics received a Buy rating due to the lower-than-expected recurrence rates of pericarditis observed in the ongoing MAVERIC trial, which suggests that their primary candidate, CardiolRx, may be effective in reducing inflammation and preventing recurrences.

: The decision to increase enrollment from 110 to up to 150 patients demonstrates the company's commitment to ensuring robust statistical power for the trial, which may lead to more conclusive results and supports a positive outlook on the potential of CardiolRx in treating inflammatory heart conditions.
